subject: design/feature-draft-local-git
statement: A round after lock preparation reverts the preparation commit, which restores the working files byte for byte; the next preparation compiles again. The draft digest that reviews and approvals bind to is computed from the working files before preparation and recomputed from the stored exact texts after it, so both give the same value for the same content (`FR-2`, `FR-16`).
